description: This file defines two custom exception classes, DataNotAvailableException and CacheFullException, used within the Orleans streaming framework to signal specific error conditions related to data availability and cache capacity.

classes.name: DataNotAvailableException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the requested data is not available.

classes.name: CacheFullException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the queue message cache is full.

methods.name: DataNotAvailableException()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a default message.

methods.name: DataNotAvailableException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a custom message.

methods.name: DataNotAvailableException(string message, Exception inner)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a custom message and inner exception.

methods.name: CacheFullException()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a default message.

methods.name: CacheFullException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a custom message.

methods.name: CacheFullException(string message, Exception inner)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a custom message and inner exception.
